for command in gcc ld make file readelf nm grep awk; do
command -v "$command" >/dev/null || {
echo "Не найдена команда: $command" >&2
exit 1
}
done
[[ "$(<VERSION)" == "1.0.0" ]] || {
echo "Ожидалась версия 1.0.0" >&2
exit 1
}
bash scripts/verify-lwip-lock.sh
grep -Fq 'test-lwip-source-lock-host' Makefile || {
echo "Makefile не содержит test-lwip-source-lock-host" >&2; exit 1; }
grep -Fq '$(MAKE) test-lwip-source-lock-host' Makefile || {
echo "test-host-suite не содержит test-lwip-source-lock-host" >&2;
exit 1; }
grep -Fq 'lwip_lock_version=1' third_party/LOCKS.sha256 || {
echo "LOCKS.sha256 не содержит lwip_lock_version=1" >&2; exit 1; }
grep -Fq 'STABLE-2_2_1_RELEASE' \
third_party/LOCKS.sha256 third_party/LICENSES.md || {
echo "lwIP release не зафиксирован в source lock/license inventory" >&2;
exit 1; }
grep -Fq 'upstream_sha256=ce0b7461c0ad9602c376f0bf07c5eb7253b48c7bf66f011c6bf3e2a96731c539' \
third_party/LOCKS.sha256 || {
echo "LOCKS.sha256 не содержит upstream archive digest" >&2; exit 1; }
grep -Fq 'BSD-3-Clause' \
third_party/LOCKS.sha256 third_party/LICENSES.md || {
echo "lwIP license inventory не содержит BSD-3-Clause" >&2; exit 1; }
grep -Fq 'file_count=107' third_party/LICENSES.md || {
echo "LICENSES.md не содержит точный file_count" >&2; exit 1; }
if grep -Eq '^C_SOURCES[^=]*=.*third_party/lwip' Makefile; then
echo "Production C_SOURCES не должен компилировать lwIP source" >&2
exit 1
fi
bash scripts/verify-mbedtls-lock.sh

third_party/LOCKS.sha256 third_party/LICENSES.md || {
echo "mbedTLS release не зафиксирован в source lock/license inventory" >&2;
exit 1; }
grep -Fq 'upstream_sha256=a7e8bcbec0e6f761b4af24f25677626b35f762f68eef79c08677a363212d11f6' \
third_party/LOCKS.sha256 || {
echo "LOCKS.sha256 не содержит mbedTLS upstream archive digest" >&2; exit 1; }

third_party/LOCKS.sha256 third_party/LICENSES.md || {
echo "mbedTLS license inventory не содержит dual license expression" >&2;
exit 1; }
grep -Fq 'file_count=272' third_party/LICENSES.md || {
echo "LICENSES.md не содержит точный mbedTLS file_count" >&2; exit 1; }
grep -Fq '9b405ef4c89342f5eae1dd828882f931747f71001cfba7d114801039b52ad09b  mbedtls/LICENSE' \
third_party/LICENSE-DOCUMENTS.sha256 || {
echo "LICENSE-DOCUMENTS.sha256 не содержит mbedTLS license text" >&2;
exit 1; }
if grep -Eq '^C_SOURCES[^=]*=.*third_party/mbedtls' Makefile; then
echo "Production C_SOURCES не должен компилировать mbedTLS source" >&2
exit 1
fi

"$mbedtls_doc"; then

exit 1
fi
done

verify_ci_leaked_qemu_guard() {
local ci_file=$1
local step_text
local pattern_line
local pattern_count
local pattern_text
local pattern
local fragment
step_text=$(awk '
/^[[:space:]]*- name:[[:space:]]*Check for leaked QEMU processes[[:space:]]*$/ { inside = 1; next }
inside && /^[[:space:]]*- name:/ { exit }
inside { print }
' "$ci_file")
if [[ -z "$step_text" ]]; then
echo "В $ci_file отсутствует шаг Check for leaked QEMU processes" >&2
return 1
fi
pattern_line=$(printf '%s\n' "$step_text" |
grep -n "^[[:space:]]*pattern='" || true)
pattern_count=$(printf '%s\n' "$pattern_line" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)
if [[ "$pattern_count" -ne 1 ]]; then
echo "Ожидалась ровно одна строка pattern=' в шаге leaked-QEMU, найдено: $pattern_count" >&2
return 1
fi
pattern_text=$(printf '%s\n' "$pattern_line" | cut -d: -f2-)
for pattern in '[q]emu-system-x86_64' '[t]est-qemu-irqs\.sh' \
'[t]est-qemu-panic\.sh' '[t]est-qemu-pagefault\.sh' \
'[t]est-qemu-doublefault\.sh' '[t]est-qemu-nmi\.sh' \
'[t]est-qemu-acpi\.sh' '[t]est-qemu-vmm\.sh' \
'[t]est-qemu-lapic\.sh' '[t]est-qemu-ioapic-probe\.sh' \
'[t]est-qemu-ioapic-irq0\.sh' \
'[t]est-qemu-ioapic-irq1\.sh' \
'[t]est-qemu-pic-irq0-masking\.sh' \
'[t]est-qemu-pic-irq0-masking-fallback\.sh' \
'[t]est-qemu-lapic-timer-calibration\.sh' \
'[t]est-qemu-lapic-timer-runtime\.sh' \
'[t]est-qemu-keyboard-line-editing\.sh' \
'[t]est-qemu-process-scheduler\.sh' \
'[t]est-qemu-user-iretq\.sh' \
'[t]est-qemu-syscall\.sh'; do
if ! printf '%s\n' "$pattern_text" | grep -Fq -- "$pattern"; then
echo "В pgrep-строке $ci_file отсутствует шаблон: $pattern" >&2
return 1
fi
done
for fragment in \
'/proc/self/cgroup' \
'cgroup.procs' \
'while read -r pid; do' \
'grep -Eq "$pattern" <<<"$cmd"'; do
if ! printf '%s\n' "$step_text" | grep -Fq -- "$fragment"; then
echo "leaked-QEMU guard в $ci_file не сканирует процессы: нет $fragment" >&2
return 1
fi
done
for fragment in \
'[[ -z "$cg" ]]' \
'[[ ! -r "$procs" ]]'; do
if ! printf '%s\n' "$step_text" | grep -Fq -- "$fragment"; then
echo "leaked-QEMU guard в $ci_file не закрыт fail-closed: нет $fragment" >&2
return 1
fi
done
}
verify_ci_leaked_qemu_guard .github/workflows/ci.yml || exit 1
ci_guard_fixture_dir=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/hfoc-ci-guard.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$ci_guard_fixture_dir"' EXIT
ci_guard_pattern=$(grep -m1 "^[[:space:]]*pattern='" .github/workflows/ci.yml)
ci_guard_pattern=${ci_guard_pattern#*pattern=}
cat >"$ci_guard_fixture_dir/comment-only.yml" <<'EOF'
EOF
if verify_ci_leaked_qemu_guard "$ci_guard_fixture_dir/comment-only.yml" 2>/dev/null; then
echo "leaked-QEMU comment-only fixture incorrectly passed" >&2
exit 1
fi
{
printf '%s\n' '      - name: Check for leaked QEMU processes' '        run: |'
printf '          pattern=%s\n' "$ci_guard_pattern"
cat <<'EOF'
cg=$(awk -F: '/^0::/ {print $3}' /proc/self/cgroup)
procs=/sys/fs/cgroup"$cg"/cgroup.procs
if [[ -z "$cg" ]]; then
exit 1
fi
if [[ ! -r "$procs" ]]; then
exit 1
fi
leaked=0
while read -r pid; do
cmd=$(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/"$pid"/cmdline 2>/dev/null || true)
if grep -Eq "$pattern" <<<"$cmd"; then
leaked=1
fi
done < "$procs"
EOF
} >"$ci_guard_fixture_dir/complete.yml"
if ! verify_ci_leaked_qemu_guard "$ci_guard_fixture_dir/complete.yml"; then
echo "leaked-QEMU complete fixture failed" >&2
exit 1
fi
{
printf '%s\n' '      - name: Check for leaked QEMU processes' '        run: |'
printf '          pattern=%s\n' "$ci_guard_pattern"
cat <<'EOF'
cg=$(awk -F: '/^0::/ {print $3}' /proc/self/cgroup)
procs=/sys/fs/cgroup"$cg"/cgroup.procs
leaked=0
while read -r pid; do
cmd=$(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/"$pid"/cmdline 2>/dev/null || true)
if grep -Eq "$pattern" <<<"$cmd"; then
leaked=1
fi
done < "$procs"
EOF
} >"$ci_guard_fixture_dir/fail-open.yml"
if verify_ci_leaked_qemu_guard "$ci_guard_fixture_dir/fail-open.yml" 2>/dev/null; then
echo "leaked-QEMU fail-open fixture incorrectly passed" >&2
exit 1
fi
ci_guard_pattern_missing=$(printf '%s' "$ci_guard_pattern" |
sed 's/\[t\]est-qemu-syscall\\\.sh//')
{
printf '%s\n' '      - name: Check for leaked QEMU processes' '        run: |'
printf '          pattern=%s\n' "$ci_guard_pattern_missing"
cat <<'EOF'
cg=$(awk -F: '/^0::/ {print $3}' /proc/self/cgroup)
procs=/sys/fs/cgroup"$cg"/cgroup.procs
if [[ -z "$cg" ]]; then
exit 1
fi
if [[ ! -r "$procs" ]]; then
exit 1
fi
while read -r pid; do
if grep -Eq "$pattern" <<<"$cmd"; then
leaked=1
fi
done < "$procs"
EOF
} >"$ci_guard_fixture_dir/missing-script.yml"
if verify_ci_leaked_qemu_guard "$ci_guard_fixture_dir/missing-script.yml" 2>/dev/null; then
echo "leaked-QEMU missing-script fixture incorrectly passed" >&2
exit 1
fi
rm -rf "$ci_guard_fixture_dir"
trap - EXIT
grep -Fq 'test-nmi' Makefile || { echo "Отсутствует test-nmi в Makefile" >&2; exit 1; }
bash -n scripts/test-qemu-nmi.sh || { echo "Синтаксис test-qemu-nmi.sh некорректен" >&2; exit 1; }
grep -Eq '#define[[:space:]]+IST_STACK_SIZE[[:space:]]+16384' \
kernel/include/cpu.h || {
echo "Отсутствует per-CPU IST_STACK_SIZE 16384" >&2; exit 1; }
grep -Fq 'ist2_stack[IST_STACK_SIZE]' kernel/include/cpu.h || {
echo "Отсутствует per-CPU ist2_stack" >&2; exit 1; }
grep -Fq 'const void *tss_ist2_stack(void);' kernel/include/arch/x86_64/tss.h || {
echo "Отсутствует объявление tss_ist2_stack" >&2; exit 1; }
grep -Fq 'size_t tss_ist2_stack_size(void);' kernel/include/arch/x86_64/tss.h || {
echo "Отсутствует объявление tss_ist2_stack_size" >&2; exit 1; }
grep -Fq '[TSS ] IST2 stack:' kernel/src/arch/x86_64/tss.c || {
echo "Отсутствует COM1 IST2 stack range" >&2; exit 1; }

echo "ioapic_init должен вызываться до pic_init" >&2
exit 1

extract_balanced_block() {
awk -v needle="$1" '
index($0, needle) > 0 { found = 1 }
found {
print
opens = gsub(/{/, "{")
closes = gsub(/}/, "}")
if (saw_open) {
depth += opens - closes
if (depth <= 0) exit
} else if (opens > 0) {
saw_open = 1
depth = opens - closes
if (depth <= 0) exit
}
}
' "$2"
}
extract_vector_branch() {
extract_balanced_block "$1" kernel/src/arch/x86_64/interrupts.c
}
extract_balanced_from_text() {
printf '%s\n' "$2" | awk -v needle="$1" '
index($0, needle) > 0 { found = 1 }
found {
if (saw_open && depth == 1 && index($0, "} else") > 0) exit
print
opens = gsub(/{/, "{")
closes = gsub(/}/, "}")
if (saw_open) {
depth += opens - closes
if (depth <= 0) exit
} else if (opens > 0) {
saw_open = 1
depth = opens - closes
if (depth <= 0) exit
}
}
'
}
extract_ownership_if_block() {
awk '
index($0, "if (irq0_ioapic_active)") > 0 { found = 1; depth = 1; print; next }
found {
if (index($0, "} else {") > 0) exit
print
opens = gsub(/{/, "{")
closes = gsub(/}/, "}")
depth += opens - closes
if (depth <= 0) exit
}
'
}
extract_else_block() {
awk '
index($0, "} else {") > 0 { found = 1; depth = 1; print; next }
found {
print
opens = gsub(/{/, "{")
closes = gsub(/}/, "}")
depth += opens - closes
if (depth <= 0) exit
}
'
}
vector20_branch=$(extract_vector_branch 'if (frame->vector == 32U)')
vector40_branch=$(extract_vector_branch 'if (frame->vector == 0x40U)')
vector42_branch=$(extract_vector_branch 'if (frame->vector == 0x42U)')
runtime20_block=$(extract_balanced_from_text \
'if (lapic_timer_runtime_active())' "$vector20_branch")
stray20_block=$(printf '%s\n' "$vector20_branch" | extract_ownership_if_block)
fallback20_block=$(printf '%s\n' "$vector20_branch" | extract_else_block)
runtime40_block=$(extract_balanced_from_text \
'if (!lapic_timer_runtime_active() && irq0_ioapic_active)' \
"$vector40_branch")
runtime42_block=$(extract_balanced_from_text \
'if (lapic_timer_runtime_active())' "$vector42_branch")
if printf '%s\n' "$runtime20_block" | grep -Fq 'timer_handle_irq();'; then
echo "runtime active 0x20 branch вызывает timer_handle_irq()" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s\n' "$runtime20_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_send_eoi(0);'; then
echo "runtime active 0x20 branch не вызывает pic_send_eoi(0)" >&2
exit 1
fi
if printf '%s\n' "$stray20_block" | grep -Fq 'timer_handle_irq();'; then
echo "active stray 0x20 branch вызывает timer_handle_irq()" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s\n' "$stray20_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_send_eoi(0);'; then
echo "active stray 0x20 branch не вызывает pic_send_eoi(0)" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s\n' "$stray20_block" | grep -Fq 'irq0_stray_pic_count++;'; then
echo "active stray 0x20 branch не увеличивает irq0_stray_pic_count" >&2
exit 1
fi
if printf '%s\n' "$vector20_branch" | grep -Fq 'lapic_eoi'; then
echo "vector 0x20 branch вызывает lapic_eoi()" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s\n' "$fallback20_block" | grep -Fq 'timer_handle_irq();'; then
echo "fallback 0x20 else branch не вызывает timer_handle_irq()" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s\n' "$fallback20_block" | \
grep -Fq 'lapic_timer_runtime_coordinate_irq0();'; then
echo "fallback 0x20 else branch не вызывает runtime coordinator" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s\n' "$fallback20_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_send_eoi(0);'; then
echo "fallback 0x20 else branch не вызывает pic_send_eoi(0)" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s\n' "$runtime40_block" | grep -Fq 'timer_handle_irq();'; then
echo "non-runtime active 0x40 branch не вызывает timer_handle_irq()" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s\n' "$runtime40_block" | \
grep -Fq 'lapic_timer_runtime_coordinate_irq0();'; then
echo "non-runtime active 0x40 branch не вызывает runtime coordinator" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s\n' "$vector40_branch" | grep -Fq 'lapic_eoi();'; then
echo "vector 0x40 branch не вызывает lapic_eoi()" >&2
exit 1
fi
timer_total=$(printf '%s\n' "$vector40_branch" |
grep -F -o 'timer_handle_irq();' | wc -l)
timer_runtime40=$(printf '%s\n' "$runtime40_block" |
grep -F -o 'timer_handle_irq();' | wc -l)
if [[ "$timer_total" -ne "$timer_runtime40" ]]; then
echo "timer_handle_irq() в vector 0x40 находится вне verified block" >&2
exit 1
fi
if printf '%s\n' "$vector40_branch" |
grep -nE '\bpic_(mask|unmask|send_eoi)\b|\bpic_init[[:space:]]*\('; then
echo "vector 0x40 branch вызывает PIC API" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! grep -Fq 'timer_handle_irq();' <<<"$runtime42_block"; then
echo "runtime 0x42 branch не вызывает timer_handle_irq()" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! grep -Fq 'lapic_eoi();' <<<"$runtime42_block"; then
echo "runtime 0x42 branch не вызывает lapic_eoi()" >&2
exit 1
fi
if printf '%s\n' "$vector42_branch" |
grep -nE '\bpic_(mask|unmask|send_eoi)\b|\bpic_init[[:space:]]*\('; then
echo "vector 0x42 branch вызывает PIC API" >&2
exit 1
fi
if grep -Fq 'ioapic_is_irq0_routed' kernel/src/arch/x86_64/interrupts.c; then
echo "interrupts.c перечитывает ioapic_is_irq0_routed()" >&2
exit 1
fi

'FALLBACK_C_OBJS := $(patsubst kernel/src/%.c,$(FALLBACK_OBJ_DIR)/%.o,$(C_SOURCES))' \
'FALLBACK_ASM_OBJS := $(patsubst kernel/src/%.S,$(FALLBACK_OBJ_DIR)/%.o,$(ASM_SOURCES))' \
'FALLBACK_OBJS := $(FALLBACK_C_OBJS) $(FALLBACK_ASM_OBJS)' \
'FALLBACK_DEPS := $(patsubst kernel/src/%.c,$(FALLBACK_OBJ_DIR)/%.d,$(C_SOURCES)) $(patsubst kernel/src/%.S,$(FALLBACK_OBJ_DIR)/%.d,$(ASM_SOURCES))' \
'FALLBACK_KERNEL := build/fallback/hfoc-kernel.elf' \
'FALLBACK_ISO := build/fallback/hfoc-os-$(VERSION)-fallback.iso' \
'FALLBACK_ISO_ROOT := build/fallback/iso_root' \
'FALLBACK_CFLAGS := $(CFLAGS) -DHFOC_IRQ0_ROUTE_FAILURE_TEST' \
'$(FALLBACK_OBJ_DIR)/%.o: kernel/src/%.c' \
'$(FALLBACK_OBJ_DIR)/%.o: kernel/src/%.S' \
'$(CC) $(FALLBACK_CFLAGS) -MMD -MP -c $< -o $@' \
'$(CC) $(ASFLAGS) -MMD -MP -c $< -o $@' \
'-include $(FALLBACK_DEPS)' \
'$(FALLBACK_KERNEL): $(FALLBACK_OBJS) kernel/linker.ld'; do
grep -Fq -- "$fallback_contract" Makefile || {
echo "Makefile не содержит $fallback_contract" >&2
exit 1
}
done

echo "fallback ISO packaging использует production build/iso_root" >&2
exit 1
fi

echo "fallback object rules используют production build/obj" >&2
exit 1
fi
fallback_cflags_count=$(grep -F -o 'FALLBACK_CFLAGS' Makefile | wc -l)
[[ "$fallback_cflags_count" -eq 2 ]] || {
echo "FALLBACK_CFLAGS используется вне fallback graph" >&2
exit 1
}

exit 1
}
extract_policy_branch() {
local mode=$1
local needle=$2
local file=$3
awk -v mode="$mode" -v needle="$needle" '
function brace_delta(s,    i, ch, opens, closes) {
opens = 0
closes = 0
for (i = 1; i <= length(s); i++) {
ch = substr(s, i, 1)
if (ch == "{") opens++
else if (ch == "}") closes++
}
return opens - closes
}
function closing_count(s,    i, ch, count) {
count = 0
for (i = 1; i <= length(s); i++) {
ch = substr(s, i, 1)
if (ch == "}") count++
}
return count
}
function begin_else(line, idx,    tail, delta) {
tail = substr(line, idx + 4)
delta = brace_delta(tail)
if (delta > 0) {
phase = 5
depth = delta
if (depth <= 0) exit
} else {
phase = 4
}
}
index($0, needle) > 0 { found = 1; phase = 1 }
found {
if (phase == 1) {
if (mode == "if") print
delta = brace_delta($0)
if (delta > 0) {
phase = 2
depth = delta
if (depth <= 0) exit
}
} else if (phase == 2) {
if (mode == "if") {
if (index($0, "else") > 0) {
else_idx = index($0, "else")
depth -= closing_count(substr($0, 1, else_idx - 1))
if (depth <= 0) {
print
exit
}
print
depth += brace_delta($0)
} else {
print
depth += brace_delta($0)
if (depth <= 0) exit
}
} else {
if (index($0, "else") > 0) {
else_idx = index($0, "else")
depth -= closing_count(substr($0, 1, else_idx - 1))
if (depth <= 0) {
print
begin_else($0, else_idx)
} else {
depth += brace_delta($0)
}
} else {
depth += brace_delta($0)
if (depth <= 0) phase = 3
}
}
} else if (phase == 3) {
if (index($0, "else") > 0) {
print
begin_else($0, index($0, "else"))
}
} else if (phase == 4) {
print
delta = brace_delta($0)
if (delta > 0) {
phase = 5
depth = delta
if (depth <= 0) exit
}
} else if (phase == 5) {
print
depth += brace_delta($0)
if (depth <= 0) exit
}
}
' "$file"
}
extract_irq1_branch() {
extract_policy_branch "$1" 'if (irq1_ready)' "$2"
}
extract_irq0_branch() {
extract_policy_branch "$1" 'if (irq0_ready)' "$2"
}
extract_irq1_initializer() {
awk '
index($0, "const bool irq1_ready =") > 0 { found = 1 }
found {
print
if (index($0, ";") > 0) exit
}
' "$1" | tr '\n' ' ' | tr -s '[:space:]' ' '
}
extract_irq0_initializer() {
awk '
index($0, "const bool irq0_ready =") > 0 { found = 1 }
found {
print
if (index($0, ";") > 0) exit
}
' "$1" | tr '\n' ' ' | tr -s '[:space:]' ' '
}
verify_unconditional_pic_unmask() {
awk '
function is_keyword_at(s, i, kw,    n, prev, nextc) {
n = length(kw)
if (substr(s, i, n) != kw) return 0
prev = (i == 1) ? "" : substr(s, i - 1, 1)
nextc = substr(s, i + n, 1)
if (prev != "" && prev ~ /[[:alnum:]_]/) return 0
if (nextc != "" && nextc ~ /[[:alnum:]_]/) return 0
return 1
}
function push_brace(kind) {
stack_size++
stack[stack_size] = kind
if (kind == "guard") guard_depth++
}
function pop_brace(    kind) {
if (stack_size > 0) {
kind = stack[stack_size]
stack_size--
if (kind == "guard") guard_depth--
}
}
function scan_line(line,    i, ch) {
for (i = 1; i <= length(line); i++) {
ch = substr(line, i, 1)
if (is_keyword_at(line, i, "if") ||
is_keyword_at(line, i, "else") ||
is_keyword_at(line, i, "for") ||
is_keyword_at(line, i, "while") ||
is_keyword_at(line, i, "switch")) {
pending_guard = 1
} else if (ch == "{") {
if (pending_guard) {
push_brace("guard")
pending_guard = 0
} else {
push_brace("plain")
}
} else if (ch == "}") {
pop_brace()
}
if (index(substr(line, i), "pic_unmask(0U);") == 1 &&
(guard_depth > 0 || pending_guard == 1)) {
call_in_guard = 1
}
}
}
{
if (index($0, "pic_unmask(0U);") > 0) {
call_count++
call_line = NR
}
if (index($0, "timer_init(HFOC_TIMER_HZ);") > 0) {
timer_line = NR
in_segment = 1
guard_depth = 0
stack_size = 0
pending_guard = 0
}
if (in_segment && !seen_end) {
scan_line($0)
}
if (in_segment && index($0, "log_pic_masks();") > 0) {
log_line = NR
seen_end = 1
}
}
END {
if (call_count != 1) {
printf "FAIL expected exactly one pic_unmask(0U); call, found %d\n",
call_count
exit 1
}
if (timer_line <= 0 || call_line <= timer_line) {
printf "FAIL pic_unmask(0U); call line %d is not after timer_init line %d\n",
call_line, timer_line
exit 1
}
if (log_line <= 0 || call_line >= log_line) {
printf "FAIL pic_unmask(0U); call line %d is not before log_pic_masks line %d\n",
call_line, log_line
exit 1
}
if (call_in_guard == 1) {
printf "FAIL pic_unmask(0U); call is inside conditional/loop block at line %d\n",
call_line
exit 1
}
}
' "$1"
}
irq1_ready_init=$(extract_irq1_initializer kernel/src/kernel.c)
if [[ -z "$irq1_ready_init" ]]; then
echo "kernel.c не содержит const bool irq1_ready =" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s' "$irq1_ready_init" |
grep -Fq 'irq1_route_status == IOAPIC_OK && ioapic_is_irq1_routed()'; then
echo "irq1_ready не содержит exact route/routed conjunction" >&2
exit 1
fi
irq1_if_block=$(extract_irq1_branch if kernel/src/kernel.c)
irq1_else_block=$(extract_irq1_branch else kernel/src/kernel.c)
if [[ -z "$irq1_if_block" || -z "$irq1_else_block" ]]; then
echo "kernel.c не содержит полный if (irq1_ready)/else блок" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s' "$irq1_if_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_mask(1U)'; then
echo "success branch не вызывает pic_mask(1U)" >&2
exit 1
fi
if printf '%s' "$irq1_if_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_unmask(1U)'; then
echo "success branch вызывает pic_unmask(1U)" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s' "$irq1_else_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_unmask(1U)'; then
echo "fallback branch не вызывает pic_unmask(1U)" >&2
exit 1
fi
if printf '%s' "$irq1_else_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_mask(1U)'; then
echo "fallback branch вызывает pic_mask(1U)" >&2
exit 1
fi
grep -Fq 'const enum ioapic_status irq1_route_status =' kernel/src/kernel.c || {
echo "kernel.c не сохраняет ioapic_route_irq status для IRQ1" >&2
exit 1
}
grep -Fq 'const enum ioapic_status irq0_route_status =' \
kernel/src/kernel.c || {
echo "kernel.c не сохраняет ioapic_route_irq status для IRQ0" >&2
exit 1
}
irq0_ready_init=$(extract_irq0_initializer kernel/src/kernel.c)
if [[ -z "$irq0_ready_init" ]]; then
echo "kernel.c не содержит const bool irq0_ready =" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s' "$irq0_ready_init" |
grep -Fq 'irq0_route_status == IOAPIC_OK && ioapic_is_irq0_routed()'; then
echo "irq0_ready не содержит exact route/routed conjunction" >&2
exit 1
fi
irq0_if_block=$(extract_irq0_branch if kernel/src/kernel.c)
irq0_else_block=$(extract_irq0_branch else kernel/src/kernel.c)
if [[ -z "$irq0_if_block" || -z "$irq0_else_block" ]]; then
echo "kernel.c не содержит полный if (irq0_ready)/else блок" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s' "$irq0_if_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_mask(0U);'; then
echo "success branch не вызывает pic_mask(0U)" >&2
exit 1
fi
if printf '%s' "$irq0_if_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_unmask(0U);'; then
echo "success branch вызывает pic_unmask(0U)" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s' "$irq0_else_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_unmask(0U);'; then
echo "fallback branch не вызывает pic_unmask(0U)" >&2
exit 1
fi
if printf '%s' "$irq0_else_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_mask(0U);'; then
echo "fallback branch вызывает pic_mask(0U)" >&2
exit 1
fi
irq0_unmask_count=$(grep -F -o 'pic_unmask(0U);' kernel/src/kernel.c | wc -l)
[[ "$irq0_unmask_count" -eq 1 ]] || {
echo "kernel.c содержит $irq0_unmask_count вызовов pic_unmask(0U), ожидался 1 в fallback branch" >&2
exit 1
}
irq0_mask_count=$(grep -F -o 'pic_mask(0U);' kernel/src/kernel.c | wc -l)
[[ "$irq0_mask_count" -eq 1 ]] || {
echo "kernel.c содержит $irq0_mask_count вызовов pic_mask(0U), ожидался 1 в success branch" >&2
exit 1
}
grep -Fq '[PIC ] IRQ0 masked; IOAPIC vector=0x40 active.' \
kernel/src/kernel.c || {
echo "kernel.c не содержит exact IRQ0 success marker" >&2
exit 1
}
grep -Fq '[PIC ] IRQ0 unmasked; legacy PIC timer retained.' \
kernel/src/kernel.c || {
echo "kernel.c не содержит exact IRQ0 fallback marker" >&2
exit 1
}
irq0_route_line=$(grep -n 'ioapic_route_irq(0U, IOAPIC_IRQ0_VECTOR);' \
kernel/src/kernel.c | head -n1 | cut -d: -f1 || true)
publish_line=$(grep -n 'irq0_ioapic_active_publish(irq0_ready);' \
kernel/src/kernel.c | head -n1 | cut -d: -f1 || true)
publish_count=$(grep -F -o 'irq0_ioapic_active_publish(irq0_ready);' \
kernel/src/kernel.c | wc -l)
cpu_cli_line=$(grep -n 'cpu_cli();' kernel/src/kernel.c | head -n1 |
cut -d: -f1 || true)
cpu_sti_line=$(grep -n 'cpu_sti();' kernel/src/kernel.c | head -n1 |
cut -d: -f1 || true)
timer_init_line=$(grep -n 'timer_init(HFOC_TIMER_HZ);' kernel/src/kernel.c |
head -n1 | cut -d: -f1 || true)
log_pic_masks_line=$(grep -n 'log_pic_masks();' kernel/src/kernel.c |
head -n1 | cut -d: -f1 || true)
[[ -n "$irq0_route_line" && -n "$publish_line" && -n "$cpu_cli_line" &&
-n "$cpu_sti_line" && -n "$timer_init_line" &&
-n "$log_pic_masks_line" ]] || {
echo "kernel.c не содержит все требуемые Stage 3b boot policy anchor lines" >&2
exit 1
}
[[ "$publish_count" -eq 1 ]] || {
echo "irq0_ioapic_active_publish(irq0_ready) должен вызываться ровно один раз" >&2
exit 1
}
[[ "$cpu_cli_line" -lt "$irq0_route_line" &&
"$irq1_route_line" -lt "$irq0_route_line" &&
"$irq0_route_line" -lt "$keyboard_init_line" &&
"$irq0_route_line" -lt "$timer_init_line" &&
"$irq0_route_line" -lt "$publish_line" &&
"$publish_line" -lt "$log_pic_masks_line" &&
"$log_pic_masks_line" -lt "$cpu_sti_line" ]] || {
echo "Stage 3b boot ordering нарушен: cpu_cli -> IRQ1 route -> IRQ0 route -> timer_init -> publish -> log -> cpu_sti" >&2
exit 1
}
grep -Fq '[PIC ] IRQ1 masked; IOAPIC vector=0x41 active.' kernel/src/kernel.c || {
echo "kernel.c не содержит exact success marker" >&2
exit 1
}
grep -Fq '[PIC ] IRQ1 unmasked; legacy PIC fallback retained.' kernel/src/kernel.c || {
echo "kernel.c не содержит exact fallback marker" >&2
exit 1
}
pic_init_count=$(grep -F -o 'pic_init();' kernel/src/kernel.c | wc -l)
[[ "$pic_init_count" -eq 1 ]] || {
echo "kernel.c вызывает pic_init() $pic_init_count раз(а), ожидался 1" >&2
exit 1
}
if grep -nE '\bpic_(mask|unmask)\([2-9]U\)|\bpic_(mask|unmask)\(0x[2-9A-Fa-f]U\)' \
kernel/src/kernel.c; then
echo "kernel.c меняет PIC IRQ2+ маски" >&2
exit 1
fi
if grep -nE '\b(pic_reprogram|pic_remap)\b|\bIMCR\b' \

check_irq1_policy_fixture() {
local fixture_file=$1
local label=$2
local initializer
local if_block
local else_block
initializer=$(extract_irq1_initializer "$fixture_file")
if_block=$(extract_irq1_branch if "$fixture_file")
else_block=$(extract_irq1_branch else "$fixture_file")
if [[ -z "$initializer" || -z "$if_block" || -z "$else_block" ]]; then
echo "$label: fixture extractor вернул пустой результат" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s' "$initializer" |
grep -Fq 'irq1_route_status == IOAPIC_OK && ioapic_is_irq1_routed()'; then
echo "$label: fixture initializer conjunction не найден" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s' "$if_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_mask(1U)' ||
printf '%s' "$if_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_unmask(1U)'; then
echo "$label: success branch fixture не корректен" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s' "$else_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_unmask(1U)' ||
printf '%s' "$else_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_mask(1U)'; then
echo "$label: fallback branch fixture не корректен" >&2
exit 1
fi
printf 'IRQ1 policy fixture %s: OK\n' "$label"
}
check_irq1_policy_forbidden() {
local fixture_file=$1
local label=$2
local if_block
local else_block
if_block=$(extract_irq1_branch if "$fixture_file")
else_block=$(extract_irq1_branch else "$fixture_file")
if ! printf '%s' "$if_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_unmask(1U)'; then
echo "$label: extractor не обнаружил forbidden pic_unmask(1U)" >&2
exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s' "$else_block" | grep -Fq 'pic_mask(1U)'; then
echo "$label: extractor не обнаружил forbidden pic_mask(1U)" >&2
exit 1
fi
printf 'IRQ1 policy fixture %s forbidden detection: OK\n' "$label"
}
check_irq1_policy_fixture "$FIXTURE_DIR/production-good.c" "production-style"
check_irq1_policy_fixture "$FIXTURE_DIR/multiline-good.c" "multiline else"
check_irq1_policy_forbidden "$FIXTURE_DIR/production-bad.c" "production-style"
check_irq1_policy_forbidden "$FIXTURE_DIR/multiline-bad.c" "multiline else"
rm -rf "$FIXTURE_DIR"

tests/ioapic-host.c || true)
[[ "$normalized_count" -ge 5 ]] || {
echo "tests/ioapic-host.c содержит только $normalized_count проверок irq1_ready (ожидалось >= 5)" >&2
exit 1
}

strip_c_comments() {
local block=$1
printf '%s\n' "$block" |
awk '
BEGIN { in_block_comment = 0 }
{
line = ""
n = length($0)
for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
ch = substr($0, i, 1)
next_ch = (i < n ? substr($0, i + 1, 1) : "")
if (in_block_comment) {
if (ch == "*" && next_ch == "/") {
in_block_comment = 0
i++
}
continue
}
if (ch == "/" && next_ch == "/") {
break
}
if (ch == "/" && next_ch == "*") {
in_block_comment = 1
i++
continue
}
line = line ch
}
print line
}
'
}
verify_irq1_direct_state_assertion() {
local label=$1
local block=$2
local source_without_comments
source_without_comments=$(strip_c_comments "$block")
printf '%s\n' "$source_without_comments" |
awk -v label="$label" '
{
source = source $0 " "
}
END {
gsub(/[[:space:]]+/, " ", source)
search_from = 1
while (match(substr(source, search_from),
/check[[:space:]]*\([[:space:]]*![[:space:]]*ioapic_is_irq1_routed[[:space:]]*\([[:space:]]*\)[[:space:]]*,/) != 0) {
call_start = search_from + RSTART - 1
call_end = index(substr(source, call_start), ";")
if (call_end > 0 &&
index(substr(source, call_start, call_end - 1), label) > 0) {
exit 0
}
search_from = call_start + RLENGTH
}
exit 1
}
'
}
for direct_state_label in \
'masked readback mismatch does not publish IRQ1 route state' \
'final readback mismatch does not publish IRQ1 route state'; do

"$irq1_mismatch_block"; then
echo "tests/ioapic-host.c не содержит direct-state assertion с label: $direct_state_label" >&2
exit 1
fi
done

verify_ci_host_serialization() {
local ci_file=$1
local group_count
local group_line
local ci_expected_group
local fragment
group_count=$(grep -c "^[[:space:]]*group: hfoc-verify-" "$ci_file" || true)
if [[ "$group_count" -ne 1 ]]; then
echo "Ожидалась ровно одна строка group: hfoc-verify- в $ci_file, найдено: $group_count" >&2
return 1
fi
group_line=$(grep "^[[:space:]]*group: hfoc-verify-" "$ci_file" |
sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//')
ci_expected_group='group: hfoc-verify-${{ matrix.phase }}-${{ github.event_name == '"'"'push'"'"' && '"'"'main'"'"' || '"'"'pr'"'"' }}'
if [[ "$group_line" != "$ci_expected_group" ]]; then
echo "CI group не сериализует фазы host-wide в $ci_file: $group_line" >&2
return 1
fi
if ! grep -Fq 'cancel-in-progress: false' "$ci_file"; then
echo "CI group не выстроен в очередь (cancel-in-progress: false) в $ci_file" >&2
return 1
fi
for fragment in \
'HFOC_PHASE_RECORD phase=%s event=%s runner=%s heavy=%s start_utc=%s start_epoch=%s' \
'HFOC_PHASE_START_EPOCH=$start_epoch' \
'HFOC_PHASE_RECORD phase=%s event=%s runner=%s end_utc=%s end_epoch=%s elapsed=%ss'; do
if ! grep -Fq -- "$fragment" "$ci_file"; then
echo "CI не публикует overlap record в $ci_file: $fragment" >&2
return 1
fi
done
}
verify_ci_host_serialization .github/workflows/ci.yml || exit 1
ci_host_fixture_dir=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/hfoc-ci-host.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$ci_host_fixture_dir"' EXIT
cat >"$ci_host_fixture_dir/event-scoped.yml" <<'EOF'
concurrency:
group: hfoc-verify-${{ matrix.phase }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'pr' || github.run_id }}
cancel-in-progress: false
EOF
if verify_ci_host_serialization "$ci_host_fixture_dir/event-scoped.yml" 2>/dev/null; then
echo "host serialization fixture: event-scoped group incorrectly accepted" >&2
exit 1
fi
cat >"$ci_host_fixture_dir/shared-everything.yml" <<'EOF'
concurrency:
group: hfoc-verify-${{ matrix.phase }}
cancel-in-progress: false
EOF
if verify_ci_host_serialization "$ci_host_fixture_dir/shared-everything.yml" 2>/dev/null; then
echo "host serialization fixture: main push not isolated incorrectly accepted" >&2
exit 1
fi
cat >"$ci_host_fixture_dir/no-record.yml" <<'EOF'
concurrency:
group: hfoc-verify-${{ matrix.phase }}-${{ github.event_name == 'push' && 'main' || 'pr' }}
cancel-in-progress: false
EOF
if verify_ci_host_serialization "$ci_host_fixture_dir/no-record.yml" 2>/dev/null; then
echo "host serialization fixture: missing overlap record incorrectly accepted" >&2
exit 1
fi
rm -rf "$ci_host_fixture_dir"
trap - EXIT
hfoc_ci_step_block() {
local ci_file=$1
local step_name=$2
awk -v needle="      - name: $step_name" '
index($0, "      - name: ") == 1 { inside = (index($0, needle) == 1); next }
inside { print }
' "$ci_file"
}
verify_ci_heavy_lock() {
local ci_file=$1
local static_body=$2
local acceptance_body=$3
local phase
local block
local lock_command
local required
for phase in static-host acceptance-qemu; do
block=$(hfoc_ci_step_block "$ci_file" "HFOC heavy phase $phase")
if [[ -z "$block" ]]; then
echo "CI не содержит locked heavy step фазы $phase в $ci_file" >&2
return 1
fi
lock_command="scripts/hfoc-heavy-lock.sh ci-shared $phase -- scripts/ci-$phase-phase.sh"
if ! grep -Fq "$lock_command" <<<"$block"; then
echo "heavy step фазы $phase не берёт host-wide lock в $ci_file" >&2
return 1
fi
if [[ $(grep -Fc "scripts/ci-$phase-phase.sh" <<<"$block") -ne 1 ]]; then
echo "heavy step фазы $phase запускает body вне lock в $ci_file" >&2
return 1
fi
done
postmerge_block=$(hfoc_ci_step_block "$ci_file" "HFOC heavy phase postmerge")
if [[ -z "$postmerge_block" ]]; then
echo "CI не содержит locked heavy step пост-merge фазы в $ci_file" >&2
return 1
fi
if ! grep -Fq 'scripts/hfoc-heavy-lock.sh ci-exclusive postmerge -- scripts/ci-static-host-phase.sh' \
<<<"$postmerge_block"; then
echo "пост-merge фаза не берёт lock эксклюзивно в $ci_file" >&2
return 1
fi
if ! grep -Fq 'github.event_name == '"'"'push'"'"'' <<<"$postmerge_block"; then
echo "пост-merge фаза не ограничена push-событием в $ci_file" >&2
return 1
fi
shared_static_block=$(hfoc_ci_step_block "$ci_file" \
"HFOC heavy phase static-host")
if ! grep -Fq "github.event_name != 'push'" <<<"$shared_static_block"; then
echo "shared static-host фаза не исключает push-событие в $ci_file" >&2
return 1
fi
for required in \
'make check' \
'make test-host-suite' \
'make test-qemu-parallel-after-acceptance' \
'make test-production-end-to-end-acceptance' \
'shellcheck "$script"' \
'shellcheck scripts/'; do
if grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#' "$ci_file" | grep -Fq "$required"; then
echo "heavy команда вне locked phase в $ci_file: $required" >&2
return 1
fi
done
for required in 'shellcheck ' 'make check' 'make test-host-suite'; do
if ! grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#' "$static_body" | grep -Fq "$required"; then
echo "static-host body потерял команду: $required" >&2
return 1
fi
done
for required in \
'make test-release-appliance-v1-acceptance' \
'make test-https-vertical-slice-acceptance' \
'make test-hfoc-appliance-platform-release-acceptance' \
'make test-hfoc-integrated-installer-dual-boot-management-acceptance' \
'make test-nvme-production-acceptance' \
'make test-hfoc-release-documentation' \
'make test-qemu-parallel-after-acceptance' \
'make test-production-end-to-end-acceptance'; do
if ! grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#' "$acceptance_body" | grep -Fq "$required"; then
echo "acceptance-qemu body потерял команду: $required" >&2
return 1
fi
done

serial_sequence_fixture_dir=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/hfoc-serial-seq.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$serial_sequence_fixture_dir"' EXIT
cat >"$serial_sequence_fixture_dir/split.c" <<'EOF'
static void emit(void) {
serial_write("[FIXTURE] value=");
serial_write_u64(1U);
serial_write("\n");
}
EOF
if python3 scripts/check-serial-sequences.py \
"$serial_sequence_fixture_dir/split.c" 2>/dev/null; then
echo "serial sequence fixture: split marker incorrectly accepted" >&2
exit 1
fi
cat >"$serial_sequence_fixture_dir/atomic.c" <<'EOF'
static void emit(void) {
const uint64_t serial_flags = serial_sequence_begin();
serial_write("[FIXTURE] value=");
serial_write_u64(1U);
serial_write("\n");
serial_sequence_end(serial_flags);
}
EOF
python3 scripts/check-serial-sequences.py \
"$serial_sequence_fixture_dir/atomic.c" || {
echo "serial sequence fixture: atomic marker rejected" >&2
exit 1
}
rm -rf "$serial_sequence_fixture_dir"
trap - EXIT
python3 scripts/check-serial-sequences.py kernel/src/*.c || {
echo "маркеры serial собираются без serial_sequence_begin/end" >&2
exit 1
}

marker_timeout_fixture=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/hfoc-marker-timeout.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$marker_timeout_fixture"' EXIT
printf '%s\n' \
'HFOC-QEMU-MARKER-TIMEOUT marker="[FAKE] proof OK" deadline=7s' \
'timed out waiting for [FAKE] proof OK' >"$marker_timeout_fixture/timing.log"
printf '%s\n' \
'timed out waiting for [FAKE] proof OK' >"$marker_timeout_fixture/legacy.log"
printf '%s\n' \
'HFOC-QEMU-MARKER-TIMEOUT marker="[FAKE] proof OK" deadline=7s' \
'*** HFOC KERNEL PANIC *** double fault' >"$marker_timeout_fixture/panic.log"
printf '%s\n' \
'[FAKE] failed: read-only appliance status proof' \
'HFOC-QEMU-MARKER-TIMEOUT marker="[FAKE] proof OK" deadline=7s' \
>"$marker_timeout_fixture/in-guest.log"
printf '%s\n' \
'HFOC-QEMU-MARKER-TIMEOUT marker="[FAKE] proof OK"' \
>"$marker_timeout_fixture/malformed.log"
: >"$marker_timeout_fixture/empty.log"
printf '%s\n' \
'HFOC-QEMU-MARKER-TIMEOUT marker="[FAKE] proof OK" deadline=7s' \
'Kernel panic: none' >"$marker_timeout_fixture/all-clear.log"
printf '%s\n' \
'HFOC-QEMU-MARKER-TIMEOUT marker="[FAKE] proof OK" deadline=7s' \
'Kernel panic detected' >"$marker_timeout_fixture/panic-word.log"
classify_marker_timeout_log() {
bash -c '
. scripts/hfoc-qemu-failure-class.sh
hfoc_qemu_failure_classify "$1"
printf "%s|%s|%s" "$hfoc_qemu_failure_class" \
"$hfoc_qemu_failure_marker" "$hfoc_qemu_failure_deadline"
' _ "$1"
}
[[ $(classify_marker_timeout_log "$marker_timeout_fixture/timing.log") == \
'marker-timeout|[FAKE] proof OK|7s' ]] || {
echo "классификатор не распознал каноническую запись таймаута" >&2
exit 1
}
[[ $(classify_marker_timeout_log "$marker_timeout_fixture/all-clear.log") == \
'marker-timeout|[FAKE] proof OK|7s' ]] || {
echo "all-clear здорового гостя попал в assertion" >&2
exit 1
}
for marker_timeout_negative in \
legacy.log panic.log panic-word.log in-guest.log malformed.log empty.log; do

[[ ${classified%%|*} == assertion ]] || {
echo "fail-closed лог попал в повторяемый класс: $marker_timeout_negative ($classified)" >&2
exit 1
}
done

python3 - <<'PY' || {
import pathlib
import re
import sys
console = pathlib.Path("kernel/src/console.c").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
match = re.search(r'console_write\("(COMMANDS: [^"]*?)\\n"\)', console)
if match is None:
print("ITEM-418: console.c не публикует строку COMMANDS", file=sys.stderr)
raise SystemExit(1)
canonical = match.group(1)
markers = []
failures = []
for proof in ("scripts/test-qemu-lapic-timer-oneshot.sh",
"scripts/test-qemu-pic-disable.sh",
"scripts/test-qemu-console-history.sh"):
text = pathlib.Path(proof).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
proof_markers = ["".join(re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', block))
for block in re.findall(r"help_marker = \((.*?)\)\n", text,
re.DOTALL)]
if not proof_markers:
failures.append("%s: нет help_marker" % proof)
for marker in proof_markers:
markers.append(marker)
if not marker.startswith("COMMANDS: ") or marker not in canonical:
failures.append("%s: маркер не совпадает с языком консоли" % proof)
if failures:
print("ITEM-418: " + "; ".join(failures), file=sys.stderr)
raise SystemExit(1)
without_item_words = canonical.replace("REBOOT SHUTDOWN ", "", 1)
if without_item_words == canonical:
print("ITEM-418: строка COMMANDS не называет команды этого item",
file=sys.stderr)
raise SystemExit(1)
if not any(marker not in without_item_words for marker in markers):
print("ITEM-418: проверка не заметила бы вставленную команду",
file=sys.stderr)
raise SystemExit(1)
print("platform power: console vocabulary matches every proof marker")
PY
echo "ITEM-418: маркеры консольных доказательств разошлись с языком консоли" >&2
exit 1
}

QUEUE_DOC=${HFOC_QUEUE_DOC:-docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-11-appliance-productization-queue.md}
QUEUE_CHECK_DIR=${HFOC_QUEUE_CHECK_DIR:-scripts/check.d}
QUEUE_CHECK_SELF=52-queue-current-item.sh
QUEUE_CHECK_FIXTURE=238-item-565-queue-current-pin.sh
[[ -f $QUEUE_DOC ]] || {
echo "ITEM-441: отсутствует $QUEUE_DOC" >&2
exit 1
}
current_headings=$(grep -c '^## Current item$' "$QUEUE_DOC" || true)
[[ $current_headings == 1 ]] || {
echo "ITEM-441: в очереди $current_headings текущих разделов, а не один" >&2
exit 1
}
last_section=$(grep -n '^## ' "$QUEUE_DOC" | tail -1 | cut -d: -f1)
current_line=$(grep -n '^## Current item$' "$QUEUE_DOC" | cut -d: -f1)
[[ $last_section == "$current_line" ]] || {
echo "ITEM-441: текущий раздел не последний в очереди" >&2
exit 1
}
current_item=$(awk '
/^## Current item$/ { inside = 1; next }
inside && /^## / { exit }
inside { print }
' "$QUEUE_DOC" | grep -m1 -Eo 'ITEM-[0-9]+' || true)
[[ -n $current_item ]] || {
echo "ITEM-441: текущий раздел не называет номер item'а" >&2
exit 1
}
history_headings=$(grep -c '^## Item ITEM-' "$QUEUE_DOC" || true)
[[ $history_headings -ge 10 ]] || {
echo "ITEM-441: история очереди потеряла разделы ($history_headings)" >&2
exit 1
}
history_numbers=$(grep '^## Item ITEM-' "$QUEUE_DOC" |
grep -Eo 'ITEM-[0-9]+' | sed 's/^ITEM-//' || true)
[[ -n $history_numbers ]] || {
echo "ITEM-565: история очереди не называет ни одного номера" >&2
exit 1
}
current_number=${current_item#ITEM-}
max_history=$(printf '%s\n' "$history_numbers" | sort -n | tail -1)
if printf '%s\n' "$history_numbers" | grep -Fxq "$current_number"; then
echo "ITEM-565: текущий пункт ITEM-$current_number уже есть в истории" >&2
exit 1
fi
(( current_number > max_history )) || {
echo "ITEM-565: текущий пункт ITEM-$current_number не впереди истории (ITEM-$max_history)" >&2
exit 1
}
for module in "$QUEUE_CHECK_DIR"/*.sh; do
[[ ${module##*/} == "$QUEUE_CHECK_SELF" ]] && continue

if grep -Fq "'^## Current item\$'" "$module"; then

'--network static --address 10.0.2.15/24 --gateway 10.0.3.1 --dns 10.0.2.3' \
'--network static --address 10.0.2.15 --gateway 10.0.2.2 --dns 10.0.2.3'; do
if python3 scripts/hfoc-installed-config.py \
--template "$install_network_template" \
--management local-only $install_network_case \
--output /dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then
echo "ITEM-446: сборка приняла негодное объявление: $install_network_case" >&2
exit 1
fi
done
if ! install_network_output=$(python3 scripts/hfoc-installed-config.py \
--template "$install_network_template" \
--management local-only \
--network static --address 10.0.2.15/24 \
--gateway 10.0.2.2 --dns 10.0.2.3 \
--output /dev/stdout 2>/dev/null); then
install_network_tmp=$(mktemp)
python3 scripts/hfoc-installed-config.py \
--template "$install_network_template" \
--management local-only \
--network static --address 10.0.2.15/24 \
--gateway 10.0.2.2 --dns 10.0.2.3 \
--output "$install_network_tmp" >/dev/null || {
echo "ITEM-446: сборка отвергла годное объявление" >&2
rm -f "$install_network_tmp"
exit 1
}
install_network_output=$(cat "$install_network_tmp")
rm -f "$install_network_tmp"
fi

python3 - <<'PY' || exit 1
import pathlib
import re
text = pathlib.Path("kernel/src/kernel.c").read_text()
guard = "#if defined(HFOC_APPLIANCE_ACME_HTTP01_QEMU_TEST) ||"
block = None
for match in re.finditer(re.escape(guard), text):
position = match.start()
else_at = text.find("#else", position)
end = text.find("#endif", else_at if else_at != -1 else position)
if else_at == -1 or end == -1:
continue
candidate = text[position:else_at]
if "appliance_production_acme_http01_poll(" in candidate and \
"appliance_acme_http01_fixture_qemu_tick(" in candidate:
block = (candidate, text[else_at:end])
break
if block is None:
raise SystemExit("ITEM-508 inc29: фикстурная ветвь с poll и tick не найдена")
fixture, production = block
if fixture.count("appliance_acme_fixture_epoch_seconds()") != 1:
raise SystemExit("ITEM-508 inc29: часы фикстуры названы не ровно один раз")
for call in ("appliance_production_acme_http01_poll(",
"appliance_acme_http01_fixture_qemu_tick("):
index = fixture.find(call)
if index == -1:
raise SystemExit("ITEM-508 inc29: в фикстурной ветви нет " + call)
arguments = fixture[index:fixture.find(";", index)]
if "fixture_now_seconds" not in arguments:
raise SystemExit("ITEM-508 inc29: " + call + " получает не часы фикстуры")
if re.search(
r"appliance_production_acme_http01_poll\(\s*&production_acme_http01,\s*"
r"appliance_production_network_time_epoch_seconds\(\s*service_now_ms\)\);",
production) is None:
raise SystemExit("ITEM-508 inc29: production-ветвь потеряла проверенные часы")
PY

import pathlib
import re
import sys
for expectation in sys.argv[1:]:
proof, minimum = expectation.split()
lines = pathlib.Path(proof).read_text().splitlines()
found = 0
index = 0
while index < len(lines):
if "python3 -" not in lines[index]:
index += 1
continue
marker = index
while marker < len(lines) and "<<'" not in lines[marker]:
marker += 1
if marker >= len(lines):
break
name = re.search(r"<<'([A-Z_]+)'", lines[marker]).group(1)
end = marker + 1
while end < len(lines) and lines[end].strip() != name:
end += 1
invocation = "\n".join(lines[index:marker + 1])
source = "\n".join(lines[marker + 1:end])
if re.search(r"\$(?:[A-Za-z_]*SERIAL[A-Za-z_]*|[a-z_]*serial[a-z_]*)",
invocation):
normalised = ("serial_view" in invocation or
"load_serial_view" in source or
re.search(r"IOAPIC|LAPIC-TIMER", source) is not None)
if not normalised:
raise SystemExit(
f"ITEM-529: {proof}:{index + 1} читает сырой serial")
if "load_serial_view" in source:
found += 1
index = end + 1
if found < int(minimum):
raise SystemExit(
f"ITEM-529: в {proof} {found} конвертированных читалок, "
f"ожидалось не меньше {minimum}")
PY

ITEM565_CHECK=scripts/check.d/52-queue-current-item.sh
[[ -f $ITEM565_CHECK ]] || {
echo "ITEM-565: отсутствует $ITEM565_CHECK" >&2
exit 1
}
item565_tmp=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/hfoc-item565.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$item565_tmp"' EXIT
item565_history() {
local last=$1
local number
for number in $(seq 550 "$last"); do
printf '## Item ITEM-%s\n\nFixture history %s.\n\n' "$number" "$number"
done
}
item565_make_queue() {
local file=$1
local current=$2
local history_last=$3
local extra=${4:-}
item565_history "$history_last" >"$file"
{
printf '## Current item\n\n**ITEM-%s — fixture current item.**\n\nFixture body.\n' \
"$current"
if [[ -n $extra ]]; then
printf '\n%s\n' "$extra"
fi
} >>"$file"
}
item565_run() {
local queue=$1
local modules=$2
HFOC_QUEUE_DOC=$queue HFOC_QUEUE_CHECK_DIR=$modules \
bash -c 'source "$1"' _ "$ITEM565_CHECK" >/dev/null 2>&1
}
item565_expect() {
local expected=$1
local name=$2
local queue=$3
local modules=$4
if item565_run "$queue" "$modules"; then
actual=0
else
actual=1
fi
[[ $actual == "$expected" ]] || {
echo "ITEM-565: fixture '$name' returned $actual, expected $expected" >&2
exit 1
}
}
mkdir -p "$item565_tmp/modules" "$item565_tmp/bad-modules"
printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# no current-item pin here\n' \
>"$item565_tmp/modules/10-clean.sh"
cat >"$item565_tmp/bad-modules/99-pins-current.sh" <<'EOF'
grep -A 3 '^## Current item$' "$QUEUE_DOC" | grep -Fq 'ITEM-'
EOF
item565_make_queue "$item565_tmp/valid.md" 560 559
item565_expect 0 valid "$item565_tmp/valid.md" "$item565_tmp/modules"
item565_make_queue "$item565_tmp/behind.md" 555 559
item565_expect 1 behind "$item565_tmp/behind.md" "$item565_tmp/modules"
item565_make_queue "$item565_tmp/repeated.md" 561 561
item565_expect 1 repeated "$item565_tmp/repeated.md" "$item565_tmp/modules"
item565_make_queue "$item565_tmp/twice.md" 560 559 '## Current item'
item565_expect 1 twice "$item565_tmp/twice.md" "$item565_tmp/modules"
item565_make_queue "$item565_tmp/not-last.md" 560 559 '## Item ITEM-561'
item565_expect 1 not-last "$item565_tmp/not-last.md" "$item565_tmp/modules"
item565_history 559 >"$item565_tmp/unnamed.md"
{
printf '## Current item\n\n**The next item.**\n'
} >>"$item565_tmp/unnamed.md"
item565_expect 1 unnamed "$item565_tmp/unnamed.md" "$item565_tmp/modules"
item565_expect 1 pinned-module "$item565_tmp/valid.md" "$item565_tmp/bad-modules"
echo "ITEM-565: queue current-item fixtures passed"
